title: Dispose temporary SDF evaluator buffers on exceptional paths
description:
Council 100+ round resource-lifecycle review confirmed SdfProgramEvaluator.Evaluate(NativeArray<SdfOperation>.ReadOnly, ...) allocates a temporary NativeArray<float> and disposes it only after EvaluateInto returns. If EvaluateInto throws on malformed operation data, the temporary allocation is not disposed by the method.

Scope: wrap the temporary allocation/use in try/finally without changing evaluation semantics. Add a regression that exercises the exceptional path where practical, then verify normal reference/culled evaluation parity.

Do not add a broader allocation abstraction; this is a local ownership bug.

Validation gate: runtime build, focused evaluator tests, and Unity execution before closure.
